A clean light-toned infographic poster, vertical long-form layout stacked in five sections plus a bottom banner, on a warm white to pale mint gradient background (#F7FBF9 to #EAF4F0) with very subtle pale-cyan circuit-line traces in the corners, a faint dotted grid overlay, and a few floating soft translucent circles. The aesthetic is airy, fresh, and modern—soft glassmorphism with delicate 1px borders and gentle drop shadows instead of hard neon. Overall palette: teal-cyan (#00A6A6) for primary text and accents, soft sky blue (#4A90D9) for the pipeline, muted coral-pink (#E86A92) for the retrieval flow, and fresh leaf green (#3BA55D) for metrics.

At the top center, a large bold teal-cyan sans-serif Chinese title reads “视频检索工作原理”, with a soft cyan glow and a thin underline accent. Directly below, smaller slate-gray Chinese subtitle: “从海量监控录像中，秒级定位到特定画面”. Beneath it, two side-by-side rounded banners with thin colored borders on translucent white: the left, teal-bordered, holds dark-slate Chinese text “文搜视频：输入一句话，如‘穿蓝色工装的人在门口走动’”; the right, coral-bordered, holds “图搜视频：上传一张图片，找出所有包含相似目标的视频片段”.

Section 1, titled in bold teal-cyan “一、核心思路：帧级向量索引”, shows a horizontal flow diagram: a video reel breaks into individual frames, each frame becoming a soft cyan data node connected by thin lines. Four dark-slate Chinese text blocks sit around the diagram: “从视频中抽取关键帧，每帧生成一个向量”, “记录‘属于哪个视频、在视频中的什么时刻’”, “文本和图片共用同一多模态向量模型，与画面内容对齐”, and a lighter-gray note “（不整段处理视频：文件太大、无法定位到秒）”.

Section 2, titled “二、入库流程”, presents a four-step horizontal flowchart in rounded white cards linked by soft sky-blue arrows. Step labels in dark slate Chinese: “视频投递：自动扫描、判重、断点续跑”, “格式兼容：私有格式转标准 MP4，修正时长”, “自适应抽帧：帧差分析识别活动，有人车活动 2 秒/帧，安静时段 30 秒/帧”, “向量化入库：向量存入向量库，预览图存入文件系统”.

Section 3, titled “三、检索流程”, is a five-step flowchart connected by muted coral-pink arrows, steps in dark slate Chinese: “输入转向量”, “向量相似度检索”, “聚合去重：同视频按 10 秒时间桶归并，最多留 3 个时刻”, “可选精排：命中帧送精排模型复评”, “结果展示：预览帧 + 时间点，点击即播”.

Section 4, titled “四、实际效果与成本”, arranges four soft white rounded cards with subtle shadows in a 2×2 grid. Each card holds one metric in dark slate Chinese with fresh-green accent numbers: “图搜相似度达 0.97 以上，可精确定位到秒”; “35 分钟视频约 2~5 分钟处理（64 核 CPU + 4 个 L40 GPU）”; “2722 个视频（约 1500 小时）6 小时 3 分钟入库完成”; “三十万级帧索引，毫秒~秒级响应”.

At the bottom, a wide pale-blue translucent rounded banner with soft glassmorphism holds a glowing target icon with a radar sweep and bold dark-teal Chinese text “一句话总结：把视频拆成帧向量，用多模态模型对齐文本和图像，实现秒级精准定位”.

The whole piece is purely digital infographic design, no photographic elements, crisp and readable, all Chinese glyphs accurate at large size, generous white space, balanced spacing and clear hierarchy.
